description: Apply a swatch as fill or stroke to a page item, or to the text of a text frame

colorType.description: Apply the swatch to the fill or the stroke

itemIndex.description: Index within the targetType collection on the page (see targetType)

pageIndex.description: Page index (0-based); defaults to the active page

targetType.description: Collection itemIndex counts in: pageItem = page.allPageItems (the list_page_items numbering); text and textFrame = page.textFrames (text = the text inside the frame); rectangle, ellipse, polygon = page.rectangles, page.ovals, page.polygons

name: apply_color
title: Apply Color
